complete_relation_controls.arbitrary_relation_coverage: Any nonempty ordered C4/A2 relations join as the union of their singleton fibers in this one literal frame.
complete_relation_controls.scope: Abstract complete relations, not source realizations.

paper_dependencies: original component slack and complete ordered six-contact gluing
fixed-Sigma edge-minimal private-factor witnesses and short-support lemma
same-source circular support envelopes with spans at least two and sum at most five
original external root-to-boundary paths through the other component
four-contact capacity at most two and original binary pair path-bag identity
same original binary path bags and common two-frame-arc K5
scope: t=0 original (4,2) whole-source exclusion, conditional on the paper structural and same-embedding support lemmas

source_controls.envelope_endpoint_rule: Endpoints are actual same-source attachments; envelope interiors only permit attachment positions.
source_controls.geometry_completeness: Rotate the first actual C4 envelope endpoint to b0. Both spans are at least two and total at most five; the residual cyclic gap is zero or one, giving these four named canonical shapes.
